integrity: Claim proved by symbolic inequalities, explicit equality constructions and a finite diagnostic; independent validation has not been performed. The 2025 source is a distinct generalized Zbăganu invariant.
scientific_limitations: Real finite cubes, n>=4; values at still smaller dimensions and uniqueness of maximizing tuples are not asserted. A 2026-11-18 n-th paper is supporting comparison only, not the qualifying 2025 source.
title: Sharp penultimate Walsh-dimension geometric signed-product constant for real cubes
